name: limit-compact
description: Compacts a large session just before the account's 5-hour limit, while its prompt cache is warm, so the next account has little to load.

triggerPercent.title: Compact at 5-hour usage (%)
triggerPercent.description: Compact when the account's 5-hour window reaches this much.

minTokens.title: Only sessions of at least (tokens)
minTokens.description: Smaller sessions are cheap to load on another account and are left alone.

instructions.title: What the summary must keep
instructions.description: Passed to the compaction: what the summary should keep or stress.
instructions.default: Keep the current task and its status, decisions made and why, open files and exact paths, commands and their results that still matter, and what to do next.
